scientific_scope: Action-level schedule dependence is established on the frozen outcome-suppressed Stage-0 panel. Whether the schedule intervention changes official closed-loop task success remains unadjudicated on the 40-episode panel.

failed_resource_smoke.root_cause: The four simultaneously live official LIBERO environment processes alone crossed the frozen 82% host-RAM ceiling before the single X-VLA model could be loaded. The runner used spawn, created the workers before model load, and did not duplicate the model. Reducing the number of live environments, replacing actual four-shard arrival with state multiplexing, or changing the schedule would alter the frozen scientific intervention.

resource_projection.method: Conservative additive projection from the clean-host four-environment-only increment and the independently measured clean-host Stage-0 single-model increment. It is a capacity-planning estimate, not an executed full-path peak.
resource_projection.interpretation: The observed environment-only path already requires at least 25.828 decimal GB total to remain below 82%. The conservative full-path projection slightly exceeds the 82% budget of a 32 GiB host, so 32 GB cannot be certified. A 48 GB host is the smallest standard tier with defensible headroom; 64 GB is not required by current evidence.

repairs.reason: The model was not duplicated and no optional prefetch or outcome buffer existed. Every apparent memory reduction that makes the run fit changes the preregistered simultaneous four-shard schedule or the frozen safety ceiling.

reopen_condition: Provide or authorize a scientifically equivalent host with at least 48 GB physical RAM, zero WSL swap, no CPU/disk model offload, and the unchanged 82% ceiling; then create a fresh immutable closed-loop run and repeat preflight plus the exact four-environment resource smoke before any scientific episode.
smallest_user_action: Run the frozen branch on a clean 48 GB-or-larger host, or explicitly authorize a new independent scientific protocol whose concurrency intervention differs from the current four-shard gate. The latter would be a new study and cannot reuse the current closed-loop preregistration as if unchanged.
